name: dev.mcpharbor.gateway/nasa
title: NASA Open APIs
description: NASA astronomy picture of the day and near-earth asteroid tracking from NeoWs

compliance.attribution: NASA should be acknowledged as the source of the material
compliance.notes: Some APOD images are third-party copyrighted (see the copyright field) and are not public domain.
compliance.reasoning: NASA-produced content and open science data are generally public domain and usable for any purpose including commercial, and api.nasa.gov issues free registered keys meant for third-party developer use, fitting a shared-key gateway. Caveat: some APOD images are third-party copyrighted (marked in the 'copyright' field) and must not be redistributed commercially without the photographer's permission, so the gateway should surface/respect that field rather than assume every image is public domain.

evidence.quote: NASA content ... generally are not subject to copyright in the United States
must not explicitly or implicitly convey NASA's endorsement of commercial goods or services
